rationale_evidence.anchor: Nine of ten are refuted, and none is refuted because Reiter is wrong. Each fails because a Reiter construct is well-defined relative to assumptions KnowledgeOS does not satisfy ... Reiter's machinery is available exactly to the extent that KnowledgeOS supplies the assumptions it requires — and the assumptions are precisely the programme's open items.
rationale_evidence.statement: Central interpretive finding: the nine refutations are not evidence Reiter 'does not transfer' but a precise diagnostic mapping -- each Reiter construct is available to KnowledgeOS exactly to the extent KnowledgeOS supplies the assumptions the construct requires (causal completeness, consistent effects, factive knowledge, an existing action theory), and those exact assumptions are the programme's own remaining open items (Contr, Qualify, equality, operation registry).
